recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future edits to this extension, if any, should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than in the FHIR core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-33120 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution requesting a standard Immunization extension for the procedure associated with an immunization event. The approved design uses CodeableReference so an instance can carry either a code or a reference to Procedure, and intentionally has no value set because procedure coding varies by location.
initial_application: Core commit ef4b1ff22527c07e7cc9d3686921bf13044c5cd4 applied the issue by adding source/immunization/structuredefinition-extension-immunization-procedure.xml and wiring it into Immunization package files. The applied source used the immunization-procedure canonical URL, Immunization context, CodeableReference value type, and Procedure target profile.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed the Immunization procedure StructureDefinition during the broader move of standard extensions out of the R5 core source. The current FHIR Extension Pack source at input/definitions/Immunization/StructureDefinition-immunization-procedure.xml contains the active artifact, and the Extension Pack IG includes input/definitions/* in build scope. FHIR-36059 is a duplicate/background issue asking for an Immunization procedure code.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined FHIR core branch. No core source was changed because restoring the deleted StructureDefinition to core would conflict with the migration of extension definitions to the FHIR Extension Pack.

related_jiras.note: Duplicate/background request for an Immunization procedure code; PH minutes identified it as similar to FHIR-33120, so it was not decided separately.
